rows.reason: Selected numeric CSC/CSR/value/level/workspace arrays are cudaMalloc device allocations, uploaded before numeric work. CPU NICSLU symbolic preprocessing/leveling precedes LUonDevice; CPU solve reads factors only after final completion/D2H. All six native entries launch in the ordered default stream. Julia sets legacy stream explicitly; JACC specs bind legacy stream, KA uses the current legacy task stream. Nstreams=16 is a workspace slot/host batching constant, not16CUDAstreams. There is no live CPU producer or other-stream GPU kernel required to release a running kernel.

read_write_and_progress_model.GPU: Reads sparse structural indices/levels; modifies numeric values and tmp workspace; kernels ordered on legacy/default stream.
read_write_and_progress_model.CPU: Symbolic analysis/leveling before uploads; host-level schedule uses fixed symbolic metadata; solve/physicalLUchecks after factor D2H.
read_write_and_progress_model.Nstreams: 16integer workspace slots, no corresponding cudaStreamCreate in selected integrated numeric path.

requirements: Restore the entire mutable factor val_dev AND tmpMem state before every replay pass, not merely final C/output. Workspace is10353*nFloat32 words (~4.11GB for fullASIC), written and cleared during numeric work even though outside-ROI captures are allzero.

Factorize→update→clear kernel ordering and between-level dependency must remain exact. CPU solves and independent fullLUproduct/system residual checks must still pass; preserve all immutable indices and before/after workspace checks.
Float32 atomic updates may vary summation order. Apply original declared numerical/backward-error contract, not fabricated exact factor bytes or relaxed tolerances.

Checkpoint overhead/device-or-host backup memory pressure may be large; budget active device/host memory and preserve any profiler failure. It does not justify reducing the source problem or omitting workspace restoration.

First each name/geometry does not represent all48kdispatches, level/column states or six entry variants. CPU NICSLU preprocessing/solve is outside original numeric ROI and must not contribute invented GPU FLOPs/bytes.

rows.reason: The selected wrapper alternates CPU and GPU frontier phases. CPU source worker call joins before return; a CPU phase completes before host state is uploaded for GPU work. GPU phase uses separate cudaMalloc/CuArray cost/color/q1/q2/sc buffers and completes before scalar D2H/host frontier decision. Each GPU launch handles a finite snapshotted input frontier with device-local atomic head/tail; no host worker feeds the running kernel.

read_write_and_progress_model.CPUphase: Operates host vectors only; outer worker std::thread joins before hostlevel returns.
read_write_and_progress_model.handoff_to_GPU: Cost/color/q1/q2/sc H2D, contextsync; scalar reset upload before each launch.
read_write_and_progress_model.GPUphase: Device-only finite frontier, atomichead/tail and relaxation updates; contextsync then scD2H/hostdecision and final stateD2H.

requirements: Restore ALL mutated device cost/color/outputqueue/head/tail/overflow/iteration state before extra passes. Otherwise later passes consume an advanced head/frontier or accumulated relaxations and are not the original kernel instance.
Keep snapshot nt/gray shade, queue parity, threshold128 and120blocks. CPU/GPU handoff is serial and explicit; do not replace it by a GPU-only traversal or a live CPU/GPU shared frontier.

Frontier order is nondeterministic; preserve original fullInt32cost-vs-independent-Dijkstra, actual graph inputs, queue/scalar/redzone/overflow validation and original raw-queue-identity limitation. Do not require or manufacture equal raw queue order.

First function/geometry selects only one evolving frontier despite same grid acrosslevels. Sourceprimary time sums CPU+completedGPUsegments, excludes transfers/control/observers; profile kernel counters cannot supply fullCPU/GPUalgorithm FLOPs or pipeline bandwidth.
No managed/mapped host allocation backs selected GPU frontier arrays; do not infer AtomicSystemWide semantics from std::atomic in the CPU helper.
rows.measurement_alternative: Conditional per-kernel replay with complete frontier snapshot restore. If source progress or independent final cost checks fail, preserve evidence and review application replay retaining allCPUlevels/handoffs; select exact frontier state explicitly before any fullworkload aggregate.
